metadata.description: Wire format for `vibe self releases [--all] --json` (`vibe-self-releases/1`, PROP-019 `#release-sources`): the releases the effective source offers, newest first, and which of them this machine already holds. Source of truth for `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/self_releases_report/mod.rs`.
The source the listing was read from, as `vibe self source --json` reports it — its own `protocol` member included.
The listed releases, newest first; the newest ten without `--all`. `[]` when the source offers none. Required member: an absent key would make the document invalid by this same schema (rule R21).
More releases exist than are listed; `--all` lists every one.
One release the source offers, and what this machine does with it.
A tagged release install of this version exists in the store.
It is the active instance the shims resolve to.
It is the instance this process is running from.
